## Goal

The six S03 cards play both faces by their text and the issue's readings, each in its own script file with base and Radiant tests: S+ #3 High Evolutionary, #75 J-lease S-Space EX-plorer, #75.1 its Pack, #87 Frontier Flora, #93 Recessive Replicators and #163 Accelerationist. Frontier Flora needs one engine fact. An Animated card becomes a Unit only with a stat line its definition gives it (R2280000). A Flora with no printed stats would never animate, and a printed 0/0 would die as it enters. So `Script` gains `stat_line_when`, and placing a Plague Counter owes the card its animation (R3542000).

If a golden check goes red, report it as a bug; do not re-bless it.
- **Hidden information.** The Pack on top of the library is public through the EX-plorer's text. Add no event; the library stays hidden otherwise (R97).
- **Lost extra run.** If Replicators leaves the field before a queued extra Evolve run resolves, that run is lost. R3536003's queue already behaves this way, so this is accepted.
- **Name comments.** `names --check` refuses a comment that gives a cost or stats, so use stand-ins wherever a test needs numbers.

- **Frontier Flora's reading.** R3542000 keeps Flora a Field Spell until it has a counter. The issue's reading says it is a Unit on the field, but with no counter it would be a 0/0 and die on entry. A person may want another reading.

- **Difficulty.** Hard, as rated: the part changes an engine rule.
